req_desc: The product serves a marketing surface beside a learning surface under one name.
Every seeded learner can sign in with the pinned password `deku-demo-pw-2026` ...
Signup with an existing email is refused, writing no second account row.
Anonymous sample progress moves to the new account created from the same browser.
The subject picker lists forty-two subjects in promoted order ...
Only three subjects are open: `english`, `chess`, `math` ...
Every open subject page exposes two playable samples from the first unit ...
The english subject is taught from Spanish ...
Two language runs declare their own language on a subject page.
Enrolment is idempotent for one subject, leaving one row with the goal intact.
A lesson session is assembled with twelve exercises ...
Session assembly respects the type run, the concept run, the interleave positions, the opening ease.
Attempt states are the four pinned values `correct`, `correct_with_note`, `incorrect`, `skipped`.
A wrong answer is requeued once as a different exercise for the same concept.
The frustration guard ends a concept after three wrong attempts inside one session.
An interrupted session is resumable, offered rather than resumed silently.
Session reconcile is idempotent, so a second report does not double count ...
Concurrent session reports produce one accepted result with nothing half-written.
An out of order attempt report is refused, storing nothing.
An attempt faster than the human floor earns nothing.
A browser clock offset never moves an award.
Traces are rebuildable from the attempt log alone.
Recall probability matches the pinned formula with the half-life inside its clamp.
Due time matches the pinned formula at the default target retention `0.90`.
Trace evaluation is deterministic at one instant.
A returning learner is not buried by the backlog, seeing a proportion of the subject ...
The ability estimate moves without loosening what counts as correct.
Hearts regenerate on read, carrying the partial interval forward.
A wrong answer in a lesson costs one heart ...
Lesson progress survives running out of hearts.
Practice restores one heart at most once per interval.
The streak is recomputed from history on read against a stored local date.
A timezone change does not shorten the streak.
The day boundary survives both daylight transitions under the declared day shift.
A streak freeze is consumed once per local date.
Streak repair restores the exact previous length.
Experience awarded matches the pinned table for a lesson, a review, a practice, a perfect run, a first run of the day.
The promotion zone with the demotion zone partition the board seven up, five down.
Cohort standings order breaks ties by the earlier earner.
The cohort week closes at one instant for every member, then freezes.
The reader's own standings row is current after earning.
Unit progress is never reduced by a write.
The session is pinned to a subject version at assembly.
The subject graph is validated at load for acyclicity, reachability, concept order.
Subject content safety checks refuse a subject whose bank or solution is bad.
An untranslated guidebook falls back with a marker rather than staying hidden.
An expired token is denied on every protected route.
A password hash is never returned by any endpoint.
The accepted answer set expands from the declared grammar inside its ceiling.
Normalization order is applied before comparison, folding case after the control characters go.
A typo within threshold is accepted with a note rather than silently.
A missing accent is accepted with a note rather than silently.
A near miss that is a taught word is marked incorrect.
A free word order answer is matched as a multiset over the declared tokens.
A word bank holds no valid alternative answer among its distractors.
The word bank shuffle is stable across a reload.
A free text answer is never filtered by character.
A regrade refunds hearts without touching settled standings.
The feed route serves the same page as the root under one title.
No learner count or efficacy claim appears on any public page.
Every internal link on a public route resolves.
The terms page is linked from the signup form beside the privacy page in every footer.
An unknown address answers not found with the pinned title `Error 404` ...
A mistyped subject address renders the picker page ...
Page views are recorded, readable by their owner alone.
Long form pages carry contents, a dated summary, a capped measure.
The first view of the marketing page ships no binary inside its transfer ceiling.
An answer is marked on the page with the result appearing without a page load.
The site-language list writes each language in that language's own name.
The preference panel records a refused cookie category that survives a reload.
No percentage, mastery figure or draining bar appears on the profile ...
A held-back account is never publicly marked, staying in its cohort mid-week.
The editorial route uses the same tokens as every other route.
The two paid tier pages carry no price.
An empty history renders its own empty state ...
Learner routes resolve at their pinned addresses beside the public ones ...
Pressing the primary action carries a visitor through signup onto the learner path ...
Walking the path to the next unit through twelve exercises ends on a summary ...
The session summary reads one experience total beside one streak after a finished lesson ...
The learner path shows only the signed-in account's own subject.
Changing the timezone leaves the streak count unchanged on the profile.
Body text meets the contrast bar against its own background ...
A wrong answer carries a cross shape beside a word rather than colour alone.
Public routes declare unique preview titles beside a description, with the preview image resolving ...
Attempt rows persist, surviving a reread as the source of every derived number ...
The cohort holds twelve seeded members at `Bronze` inside the capacity ceiling ...
A trace row is unique on the account with the concept, rebuildable from the attempt log.
The session row carries a reconcile mark written once, so a repeat cannot double count.
The streak row holds the last completed day as a date recomputed on read.
The hearts row holds a refill mark that a read leaves in place.
Unit states are keyed by unit identity rather than by position, never reduced by a write.
The courses table carries forty-two subject rows in picker order.
The path chrome shows the streak flame, the experience gem, the hearts, the league trophy.
The history timeline reads one entry for that lesson, newest first.
The exercise player fills the screen with one exercise beside a progress element.
No address outside the application is referenced anywhere in the build ...
The health endpoint returns ok once the app is ready behind its production server ...
List endpoints return top level arrays ...
